items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring; Rapoport corroborated the downgrade from prior doubtful path.
items.why: Hamstring injury; limited practice then downgraded Saturday.
items.implication: BAL WR room reduced to crumbs; Andrews/Bateman targets rise.
items.opportunity: Mark Andrews target share boost; Rashod Bateman flex upside.

items.text: Brock Bowers doubtful for Sunday; Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White. ETR listed OUT OR DOUBTFUL.
items.why: Knee (meniscus trim recovery); elevations signal low likelihood.
items.implication: Michael Mayer fringe TE1 opportunity if inactive.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs NE due to foot injury (LP-DNP-DNP).
items.implication: PIT WR crumbs; DK Metcalf primary.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining PIT pass-catchers.

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT/DOUBTFUL on ETR Sunday board (hamstring); multiple sources confirm OUT for Week 2 vs CIN.
items.implication: HOU WR volume to secondary options and Schultz; routes/targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz TE1 path; Boutte/Hutchinson/Noel deep flex.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed Q for MNF vs Giants (hip); McVay said no Sat practice, some groin soreness post-Thu practice (unrelated to camp), likely pregame decision. Whittington doubtful (quad).
items.why: Hip injury + groin soreness; missed consecutive practices.
items.implication: If out, heavier TE usage (Ferguson/Parkinson) and Konata Mumpfield/Malachi Fields bump.
items.opportunity: TE/WR depth chart elevation if inactive.

items.text: Joe Burrow Q but expected to play; Bengals elevated Josh Johnson. ETR notes 'said he's playing'.
items.why: Back issue but positive coach/player signals + elevation as precaution.
items.implication: Full CIN offense likely; Chase/Higgins/Brown intact.

items.text: Alvin Kamara expected/IN back; Berry flags reduced Etienne Week 1 workload + Kamara return further squeezes Etienne (esp. passing role) as underdogs @ BAL. Graziano intel on show.
items.why: Kamara return + Etienne W1 air-heavy/low rush share.
items.implication: Etienne hate; committee split favors Kamara.
items.opportunity: Kamara workhorse path; Etienne sit/flex only.
items.conflict: Usage data shows Etienne pass reliance vulnerable.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate per Levitan; Q status impacts Justin Herbert projections heavily and game is 4pm ET. Limited practice Friday.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; limited Friday.
items.implication: Herbert volume/efficiency down if limited/out; QJ/others rise.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston target bump if McConkey limited/out.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN; Levitan notes Patriots desperately need playmakers—potential 10+ touches in 2026 debut vs Stevenson + AJ Brown IR.
items.why: IN on board; NE playmaker need after Brown IR.
items.implication: RB committee shakeup; Stevenson share pressure.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless, but Kaelon Black (groin) Q status matters for SF RB split.
items.why: Strong W1 usage; Black Q could consolidate further.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry/route share expansion if Black limited.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (team lead); IND just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite W1 utilization + soft IND run matchup.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: 99 utilization W1 (tied Bijan lead), 19% tgt share last 10, 25+ touches in 3/4 recent.
Bucky Irving LOVE: RB9 util W1, 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches; CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC; out-routed Gainwell.
items.why: Passing/RZ dominance + soft CLE run D.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE: only 8% tgt share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ looks; SEA allows 3rd-fewest WR fantasy PPG.
items.why: Low target hierarchy + tough SEA matchup.
